name: status-model
title: The status model and the entity levels: three tables, a bridge, a chain of custody

research.description: Synthesis and devil's advocate over both briefs

msft.description: Reviewer brief: Microsoft, Extending GitHub Spec Kit

fowler.description: Reviewer brief: martinfowler.com, Kiro, spec-kit, and Tessl

spec.why: The owner could not read the status vocabulary page: one table mixed containers, node kinds, records, and reports. Field research shows the whole SDD tool landscape leaves statuses implicit; our machine-owned states are the differentiator, but the model under the page was never articulated. This initiative articulates it and rebuilds the page on it.

stories.as: a reader with GitHub Spec Kit experience
stories.want: a bridge from the field's words (memory bank, constitution, spec, plan, tasks) to ours (wiki, pack, pack sections, node kinds)
stories.so: I can map every term I know onto this system in one look

requirements.text: The vocabulary page MUST be rebuilt as three tables that never mix kinds: entity kinds (what exists, what contains what), state machines (which kinds have states, who moves them), and reports (transient machine output). The word 'family' MUST NOT appear as a contract term.

scenarios.when: a reader checks any table row
scenarios.then: the row names one kind of thing only: a container, a node kind, a record, or a report; no table mixes them

requirements.text: The page MUST carry a bridge table mapping the field vocabulary (memory bank, constitution, spec, plan, tasks, checklist) to this system's artifacts (wiki, AGENTS.md, pack, pack.spec, pack.plan, pack.tasks, coverage report), citing the research briefs.

scenarios.when: a reader knows only the field words
scenarios.then: every field word maps to a named artifact here or is marked absent with a reason

requirements.text: The guard MUST extend to the new tables: every state machine row equals the schema enums and the code constants, and every entity-kind row names a real schema definition or a real report path.

The chain of custody between packs MUST be decided by the owner: either packs gain a supersedes link (spec-anchored chain of custody, queryable reference lineage) or the absence is documented as a deliberate spec-first choice. The decision MUST be recorded before any implementation task runs.

constraints.text: No engine behavior changes: this wave is the model, the page, the bridge, and the guards. The frozen status-vocabulary pack is reference only.
No accepted decisions at authoring: every decision ships proposed; the owner accepts or rejects after reading the research.

clarifications.question: Should packs carry a supersedes link to the pack they replace, making the spec-anchored chain of custody explicit and queryable?
Should user-facing output adopt the field's words (spec, plan, tasks) alongside ours (pack, pack sections), or keep this system's vocabulary alone?

out_of_scope: any change to loom commands, schemas, or state machines
semantic search over complete packs (a future consumer)

plan.approach: Rebuild the page on the three-table model, add the bridge with citations, extend the guards, and leave the supersedes question to the owner before T-3 runs.

stack.guards: pytest reading the schema and the page

designs.title: Three tables: entity kinds, state machines, reports
designs.detail: Table 1 entity kinds: pack (container), node kinds US, FR, CON, Q, D, DES, T, DG (graph nodes), evidence (record on a task), verdict (record in review). Containment stated: the pack contains nodes; nodes carry records. Table 2 state machines: pack, task, decision, question; one row each with states, mover, terminality. Table 3 reports: the seven handout statuses, transient by construction. The DONE/complete layering is explained in prose: task done is an observed fact, pack complete is an owner verdict, handout statuses are per-run output.

designs.title: The bridge table
designs.detail: One table, one row per field word: memory bank -> wiki plus AGENTS.md; constitution -> AGENTS.md rules plus wiki domain pages; spec -> the pack (one file where the field uses many); plan -> pack.plan; tasks -> pack.tasks; checklist -> the coverage report and the A checks; branch-per-spec -> absent (packs are initiative-scoped and frozen, not branch-scoped). Absent entries say so and why. Citations to brief-fowler.md and brief-microsoft.md.

designs.title: Guards over the new tables
designs.detail: The existing schema-equality guard keeps covering table 2. A new page guard parses the wiki page and asserts: every state machine row's status set equals its constant; every entity-kind row names a schema definition (or a documented report path); the word 'family' does not occur as a contract term.

decisions.decision: The status model is three tables (entity kinds, state machines, reports), never one mixed list.
decisions.because: The one-table page committed a category error: containers, node kinds, records, and reports presented as parallel 'families'. The owner's confusion was the correct review finding.

decisions.decision: The page carries a bridge from the field's vocabulary, with absences marked and reasoned.
decisions.because: The field's words (spec, plan, tasks, constitution) are the priors most readers arrive with; Fowler and the Microsoft article both use them. A contract page that cannot be entered from the field's vocabulary excludes its own audience.

decisions.decision: Machine-owned states stay, now with field evidence as the justification.
decisions.because: Fowler documents the failure of AI-interpreted checklists ('no 100% guarantee', duplicate generation). Our transitions move only through loom commands. This is the differentiator, restated on evidence.

decisions.decision: Packs gain a supersedes link to the pack they replace, making the chain of custody queryable (spec-anchored).
decisions.because: Complete packs are frozen reference; evolution opens a new pack. Today the new pack points at nothing, so lineage dies at exactly the point the field says matters over time. Fowler's spec-anchored level is this, named.

tasks.title: Rebuild the vocabulary page as three tables
tasks.detail: Per DES-1: replace the one-family table with entity kinds (with containment), state machines (with movers and terminality), and reports (transient). Explain done versus DONE versus complete in prose under the tables. Remove 'family' as a contract term. Keep the extension rule (schema enum, constant plus guard, table row).
